'''Ionizing warheads''' were a type of [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] equipped on the [[intruder missile]]s manufactured by [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]]. The warhead was designed to disrupt a target's onboard systems and overload the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]].<ref name="CCG-Intruder" />
